title: AS2 compiler: ActionConstantPool (0x88) never emitted — strings pushed inline
description:
Implemented ActionConstantPool (0x88) emission in the AS2 compiler.

## Changes
- Added two-pass approach to compiler.ts:
  - Pass 1: collectStrings() walks the AST and counts all string occurrences
  - Pass 2: builds constant pool, emits ActionConstantPool (0x88) as first action, then compiles body with pool references
- Modified pushString() to emit ActionPush type=8 (UI8 index) or type=9 (UI16 index) for pooled strings instead of type=0 (inline)
- Sub-compilers (function bodies, try/catch/finally) inherit the parent constant pool via constantPool field
- Updated and strengthened constantpool.test.ts with 8 tests covering:
  - Pool emitted as first action
  - Pool contains all string literals
  - ActionPush uses type=8 instead of inline strings
  - Repeated strings deduplicated in pool
  - Bytecode size reduction
  - Empty script produces no pool
  - UI16 index (type=9) for pools > 255 entries
